stem:
Kiran chews a piece of plain chapati for about one minute. It begins to taste sweet. He places iodine on unchewed chapati and on the chewed chapati.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The sweet taste shows saliva is breaking starch in the chapati into sugar.
Iodine on unchewed chapati can turn blue-black when starch is still present.
The sweet taste shows saliva is joining sugar into starch.
Iodine turning blue-black proves the chapati has no starch.

teacher.key_rationale: Sweet taste after chewing shows saliva breaking starch into sugar. Blue-black iodine marks starch still present in unchewed chapati.
